explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/969: Evelyn and Linfoot proved E(x) ≫ x^{1/4}, where Q(x) = (6/π²)x + E(x) and Q counts squarefree n ∈ [1,x]. E(x) oscillates in sign, so the result is an Ω-bound (|E(x)| ≥ c·x^{1/4} infinitely often), and the statement ¬(|E| = o(x^{1/4})) is exactly that. squarefreeCounting and the error term are defined correctly over natural x. Faithful.
